package domain_test

import (
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

func TestTeacherSoulIsOwnedByOnePersonalTeacherAndStudent(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	soul, err := domain.NewTeacherSoul(
		"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "student-1",
		domain.DefaultTeacherSoulSettings(), now,
	)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "student-1", soul.StudentID)
	require.Equal(t, domain.DefaultTeacherSoulPersonaCode, soul.PersonaCode)
	require.Equal(t, int64(1), soul.Version)
}

func TestTeacherSoulSettingsAreIndependentlyVersioned(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	soul, err := domain.NewTeacherSoul(
		"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "student-1",
		domain.DefaultTeacherSoulSettings(), now,
	)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	settings := soul.Settings()
	settings.DisplayName = "Ada"
	settings.VoiceStyle = "Concise_Technical"
	require.NoError(t, soul.UpdateSettings(settings, 1, now.Add(time.Minute)))
	require.Equal(t, "Ada", soul.DisplayName)
	require.Equal(t, "concise_technical", soul.VoiceStyle)
	require.Equal(t, int64(2), soul.Version)
	require.ErrorIs(t, soul.UpdateSettings(settings, 1, now.Add(2*time.Minute)), domain.ErrVersionConflict)
}

func TestTeacherSoulRejectsLearningStateShapedUnboundedValues(t *testing.T) {
	settings := domain.DefaultTeacherSoulSettings()
	settings.PersonaCode = string(make([]byte, 65))
	_, err := domain.NewTeacherSoul(
		"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "student-1", settings, time.Now().UTC(),
	)
	require.Error(t, err)
}
